title: Item:Iconic True Heart of Wood
wikitext:
[[Image:Iconic True Heart of Wood.png|right|thumb|420 px]]
[[Image:Iconic True Heart of Wood icon.png]]

'''Iconic True Heart of Wood''' is used for [[Iconic True Reincarnation]]: to reset your character's abilities, skills, change their appearance and race or class while also gaining past life bonuses, feats and more ability points starting at level 1 (or if choosing again an Iconic Hero at Level 15)

Your character must be an Iconic Hero to use this item.
Your character must be at [[level cap]] (level 30) to use this item.

An Iconic Heart of Wood can be acquired in several ways:
* Purchase it in the [[DDO Store]]. These are {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}.
* Turn in {{CoV|4200}} or {{Item|Heart Seed|42 Heart Seeds}}.  To turn these in, double-click a stack of [[Heart Seed]]s or of [[Commendations of Valor]]
